title: Weeknight Comfort
subtitle: Meals that come together in under an hour
description: For the nights when you need something warm and reassuring on the table without a fuss. These recipes rely on pantry staples, simple techniques, and the kind of flavors that feel like a deep exhale after a long day.

curatedBy.name: Elena Marchetti
curatedBy.bio: Food writer and recipe developer with a love for rustic Italian cooking.

title: Spring Lunches
subtitle: Light, bright, and full of the season's best produce
description: Spring asks for a different kind of lunch — one built around crisp greens, tender peas, citrus vinaigrettes, and the kind of salads that actually leave you satisfied. These recipes celebrate the season without weighing you down.

curatedBy.name: Sofia Chen
curatedBy.bio: Nutritionist and recipe writer specializing in vibrant, plant-forward food.

title: Soft Foods for Rainy Days
subtitle: Gentle, warming, made for staying in
description: When the rain is steady against the windows and leaving the house feels unreasonable, these are the recipes you reach for. Soft polenta, creamy risotto, custardy Dutch babies — food that wraps around you like a blanket.

curatedBy.name: James Whitfield
curatedBy.bio: Chef and food photographer focused on seasonal British cooking.

title: Dinner Party Starters
subtitle: Impressive first courses that let you stay with your guests
description: The best dinner party appetizers are the ones you can prepare ahead, plate quickly, and serve without disappearing into the kitchen. From a jeweled roasted cauliflower to an elegant beet salad, these starters set the tone for an unforgettable evening.

curatedBy.name: Amira Hassan
curatedBy.bio: Home cook and food stylist drawing on Middle Eastern and North African flavors.
